about: Every feature of the site and the files it is made of. The Builder reads this to label checkpoints (Feature: ...) and to bring old features back. Keep it up to date: add a feature when you build one, and remove it when the feature is deleted. Patterns: * matches inside one folder, ** matches any depth.
